H3AVSegmentPlan.description: Plan a 24 fps H3 generation window, script timing, deterministic seed and paired continuation context.

loop_ctx.name: Loop Context
loop_ctx.tooltip: Connect the MieLoop v3 context for this run and segment index.

prompts.name: All Segment Scripts
prompts.tooltip: One STRING with exactly one nonempty script per loop segment, separated by ----------SEGMENT_SEPARATOR----------.

seconds.name: New Segment Duration (s)
seconds.tooltip: Requested new content duration. The actual duration is rounded to an H3-compatible frame window at 24 fps.

overlap_frames.name: Continuation Context Frames
overlap_frames.tooltip: Shared video/audio context. Must be 17k+5, such as 5, 22 or 39; use the same value in the planner and writer.

base_seed.name: Base Seed
base_seed.tooltip: Each segment uses (base seed + segment index) modulo 2^64.

segment_prompt.name: Current Segment Script
segment_prompt.tooltip: The selected raw script. If connected to the planner, it must match the script at the current index.

audio_mode.name: Audio Mode
audio_mode.tooltip: Connect the audio mode controls; keep it unchanged within a loop.

source_audio.name: Loaded Audio
source_audio.tooltip: The recording for voice reference or audio-driven video.

0.name: Generation Prompt
0.tooltip: Text conditioning prompt. The planner adds timing, joint AV and continuation instructions.

1.name: Generation Window Frames
1.tooltip: Total frames to generate, including continuation context after the first segment.

2.name: Previous Video Context
2.tooltip: Final context frames from the preceding segment; empty on the first segment.

3.name: Previous Audio Context
3.tooltip: Audio aligned with the preceding video context; empty on the first segment.

4.name: Duplicate Context Frames to Remove
4.tooltip: Zero for the first segment; equals context frames thereafter. Remove the matching audio interval too.

5.name: Segment Seed
5.tooltip: Deterministic seed derived from the base seed and current zero-based segment index.

6.name: Speaker Voice Reference
6.tooltip: Up to the first three seconds of the first segment audio, used as a speaker identity reference in later segments.

7.name: Driving Audio Window
7.tooltip: Frame-aligned source recording with continuation context and discarded grid padding.

8.name: Frames to Keep
8.tooltip: Planner output; driving mode trims H3 grid surplus without losing source speech.

H3AVPickPrompt.description: Select the current script from a ComfyUI output list or a wrapped Python list using the MieLoop segment index.

prompts.name: Split Segment Scripts
prompts.tooltip: Connect a list of STRING scripts, one per segment, in generation order.

count.name: Segment Count
count.tooltip: Number of scripts; must agree with the MieLoop context.

loop_ctx.name: Loop Context
loop_ctx.tooltip: Connect the MieLoop v3 context for this run and segment index.

0.name: Current Segment Script
0.tooltip: The selected raw script. If connected to the planner, it must match the script at the current index.

H3AVFreezeAudio.display_name: H3 Lock Audio for Video Refinement
H3AVFreezeAudio.description: Create native per-stream noise masks so the second pass refines video while keeping audio fixed.

latent.name: Joint Video and Audio Latent
latent.tooltip: Native H3 NestedTensor latent containing the video and audio streams.

0.name: Joint Video and Audio Latent
0.tooltip: Native H3 NestedTensor latent containing the video and audio streams.

H3AVRestoreAudio.display_name: H3 Restore Original Audio After Refinement
H3AVRestoreAudio.description: Restore the first-pass audio stream into the refined joint latent after validating timing dimensions.

refined.name: Refined Joint Latent
refined.tooltip: Second-pass output; its timing dimensions must match the original latent.

original.name: Original Joint Latent
original.tooltip: First-pass output providing the original audio stream to restore.

0.name: Joint Video and Audio Latent
0.tooltip: Native H3 NestedTensor latent containing the video and audio streams.

H3AVContinuationGuide.description: Use native MiniMaxH3AddGuide to anchor previous video and audio at frame zero; pass through on the first segment.

loop_ctx.name: Loop Context
loop_ctx.tooltip: Connect the MieLoop v3 context for this run and segment index.

positive.name: Positive Conditioning
positive.tooltip: H3 positive conditioning; the continuation guide adds the paired context at frame zero after the first segment.

latent.name: Joint Video and Audio Latent
latent.tooltip: Native H3 NestedTensor latent containing the video and audio streams.

vae.name: Video VAE
vae.tooltip: Native H3 video encoder/decoder required when using video guides or references.

audio_vae.name: Audio VAE
audio_vae.tooltip: Native H3 audio encoder/decoder required when using audio guides or references.

previous_frames.name: Previous Video Context
previous_frames.tooltip: Final context frames from the preceding segment; empty on the first segment.

previous_audio.name: Previous Audio Context
previous_audio.tooltip: Audio aligned with the preceding video context; empty on the first segment.

0.name: Positive Conditioning
0.tooltip: H3 positive conditioning; the continuation guide adds the paired context at frame zero after the first segment.

H3AVEncodeSegment.display_name: H3 Trim and Write Synchronized Segment
H3AVEncodeSegment.description: Remove duplicate video/audio context together and save H.264 video, exact-length PCM audio and the next continuation tail.

loop_ctx.name: Loop Context
loop_ctx.tooltip: Connect the MieLoop v3 context for this run and segment index.

images.name: Video Frames
images.tooltip: Decoded RGB IMAGE batch shaped [frames, height, width, 3]; H.264 requires even width and height.

audio.name: Segment Audio
audio.tooltip: Decoded AUDIO with waveform [1, channels, samples] and a positive sample_rate, from the same segment as the video.

expected_frames.name: Planned Window Frames
expected_frames.tooltip: Connect the planner window_frames output; decoded frame count must match exactly.

skip_frames.name: Duplicate Context Frames to Remove
skip_frames.tooltip: Zero for the first segment; equals context frames thereafter. Remove the matching audio interval too.

overlap_frames.name: Continuation Context Frames
overlap_frames.tooltip: Shared video/audio context. Must be 17k+5, such as 5, 22 or 39; use the same value in the planner and writer.

crf.name: H.264 Quality (CRF)
crf.tooltip: Constant rate factor, 0–51. Smaller values improve quality and increase file size; default 19.

preset.name: H.264 Encoding Preset
preset.tooltip: medium is balanced; fast/veryfast reduce encoding time; slow spends more time on compression at the same CRF.

reject_silence.name: Reject Near-Silent Audio
reject_silence.tooltip: Reject a segment below -65 dBFS RMS and preserve raw audio diagnostics; disable deliberately for silent scenes.

continuation_images.name: Video Frames for Next Continuation
continuation_images.tooltip: Optional context source with the same frame count. Useful for keeping first-pass frames while writing refined video.

create_av_preview.name: Create Segment Preview with Audio
create_av_preview.tooltip: Create an extra preview MP4 with AAC audio; final output still uses the PCM masters.

kept_frames.name: Frames to Keep
kept_frames.tooltip: Planner output; driving mode trims H3 grid surplus without losing source speech.

0.name: Loop Context
0.tooltip: Connect the MieLoop v3 context for this run and segment index.

1.name: Video-Only Segment Path
1.tooltip: Absolute path to the video-only segment master; its paired PCM soundtrack is stored in a separate WAV.

2.name: Segment Diagnostics (JSON)
2.tooltip: JSON containing frame counts, source audio duration error, output samples, peak, RMS and clipping fraction.

H3AVConcat.description: Copy H.264 segments and encode the concatenated PCM audio to AAC once for the final MP4.

loop_ctx.name: Loop Context
loop_ctx.tooltip: Connect the MieLoop v3 context for this run and segment index.

done.name: Loop Finished
done.tooltip: Connect the MieLoop completion flag; concatenation runs only when true and all segments are committed.

0.name: Final MP4 Path
0.tooltip: Absolute path to the synchronized final H.264/AAC MP4.

H3AVSamplingSteps.description: Split a total sampling budget into first-pass and second-pass step counts.

总步数.name: Total Sampling Steps
总步数.tooltip: Total steps across both passes; must be greater than the first-pass count and no more than 10000.

一采步数.name: First-Pass Steps
一采步数.tooltip: Steps for the first pass; must be at least 1 and below total steps.

0.name: First-Pass Steps
0.tooltip: Steps for the first pass; must be at least 1 and below total steps.

1.name: Second-Pass Steps
1.tooltip: Computed as total steps minus first-pass steps; always at least 1.

2.name: Total Sampling Steps
2.tooltip: Total steps across both passes; must be greater than the first-pass count and no more than 10000.

H3AVReferenceListToVideo.description: Load 1–9 IMAGE_LIST paths as separate native H3 references, with optional video and voice context.

clip.name: H3 Text Encoder
clip.tooltip: The CLIP object loaded for the native H3 text/reference encoder.

images.name: Reference Image List
images.tooltip: IMAGE_LIST dictionary with items: a list of 1–9 objects containing an existing local image path. This is not an IMAGE tensor batch.

prompt.name: Generation Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Text conditioning prompt. The planner adds timing, joint AV and continuation instructions.

width.name: Video Width
width.tooltip: Target video width in pixels; use multiples of 32 for this reference encoder.

height.name: Video Height
height.tooltip: Target video height in pixels; use multiples of 32 for this reference encoder.

length.name: Generation Window Frames
length.tooltip: Total generated frames, not seconds. For segmented continuation, connect the planner window_frames output.

ref_image_size.name: Reference Image Sizing
ref_image_size.tooltip: match uses the target dimensions; max delegates the maximum reference sizing strategy to the native H3 encoder.

vae.name: Video VAE
vae.tooltip: Native H3 video encoder/decoder required when using video guides or references.

audio_vae.name: Audio VAE
audio_vae.tooltip: Native H3 audio encoder/decoder required when using audio guides or references.

previous_frames.tooltip: Final context frames from the preceding segment; empty on the first segment.

previous_audio.name: Previous Audio Context
previous_audio.tooltip: Audio aligned with the preceding video context; empty on the first segment.

speaker_reference.name: Speaker Voice Reference
speaker_reference.tooltip: Up to the first three seconds of the first segment audio, used as a speaker identity reference in later segments.

driving_audio.name: Driving Audio Window
driving_audio.tooltip: Frame-aligned source recording with continuation context and discarded grid padding.

0.name: Positive Conditioning
0.tooltip: H3 positive conditioning; the continuation guide adds the paired context at frame zero after the first segment.

1.name: Initial Joint Latent
1.tooltip: Initial native H3 joint video/audio latent returned by the reference encoder.

H3AVAudioModes.description: Separate mutually exclusive voice-reference and audio-drive switches.

voice_reference.name: Voice Reference
voice_reference.tooltip: Generate new scripted speech using a short source voice reference. Enabling this disables Audio Drive.

audio_drive.name: Audio Drives Video
audio_drive.tooltip: Keep the supplied speech fixed and generate matching mouth motion. Enabling this disables Voice Reference.

audio.name: Audio
